code='''def transform(grid):
    # The horizontal solid-color row separates a mask from a binary pattern.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    mask = grid[:sep]
    pattern = grid[sep+1:]
    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(pattern):
        mr = mask[r] if len(mask) == len(pattern) else mask[r % len(mask)]
        out.append([2 if v != 0 and mr[c] != 0 else 0 for c, v in enumerate(row)])
    return out
'''
